fixtures.title: Valid target-bound time truth claim
fixtures.purpose: Accept an ordinary truth_claim with valid tempo_claim metadata.
notes: Creation alone carries no certainty or authority.

fixtures.title: Rejected unrelated idea through narrow Tempo lane
fixtures.purpose: Reject low-threshold attempts to create unrelated content through the Tempo lane.
notes: Invalid events do not spend Tempo mana.

fixtures.title: Two identities create equivalent target-bound time claims
fixtures.purpose: Show equivalent claims share a target key while preserving separate authorship.
notes: Equivalent claims do not create certainty by count alone.

fixtures.title: Contradictory target-bound time claims
fixtures.purpose: Represent contradictory claims as ordinary visible truth claims.
notes: Contradiction remains visible and challengeable.

fixtures.title: Potential evidence spectrum consists entirely of ideas
fixtures.purpose: Represent potential evidence as hypothetical evidence ideas.

payload.proposition: A replayable source-chunk claim consistent with the anchor would be low evidence for Dmin.
Two independent canonical source-chunk claims plus consistency checks would be high evidence for Dmin.

notes: Potential evidence ideas define a spectrum but do not place actual evidence by themselves.

fixtures.title: Actual evidence consists entirely of ideas
fixtures.purpose: Create actual Tempo-context evidence as ordinary truth_claim ideas.

payload.proposition: I observed a replayable local record consistent with Dmin elapsed.

notes: Evidence ideas require explicit connections and challenge outcomes before affecting certainty.

fixtures.title: Evidence_for and evidence_against connection validation
fixtures.purpose: Use existing relative_importance connections to place evidence ideas in evidential roles.
notes: Connections define evidential role; they do not assign certainty by themselves.

fixtures.title: Placement challenge orders actual evidence against potential evidence
fixtures.purpose: Assign an evidence placement using ordinary challenge events.
notes: Placement is explicit challenge history, not heuristic scoring.

fixtures.title: Certainty-band challenge does not assign T_allow
fixtures.purpose: Assign a low certainty band to a Dmin claim through ordinary challenge verdicts without treating that verdict as structural support.
notes: T_allow is structural support, not an ordinary certainty band.

fixtures.title: Higher certainty plus diversity and stability gives beacon status
fixtures.purpose: Derive beacon status from an ordinary time claim after high certainty and diversity requirements are met.

payload.proposition: I independently inspected the target-bound claim and supporting source ideas.

notes: Beacon status is derived status of an ordinary time truth claim.

fixtures.title: One-person structural liveness without one-person beacon authority
fixtures.purpose: Use the Dmax-only structural liveness predicate to force a boundary without creating authority.
notes: The Dmax survivor path is structural only and does not assign certainty.

fixtures.title: One-person Dmin deliberative shortcut rejected
fixtures.purpose: Reject attempts to use the survivor Dmax liveness rule for Dmin or deliberative closure.
notes: A single Dmin claim remains a challengeable idea but cannot close deliberatively without ordinary certainty-band verdict history.

fixtures.title: Contradiction blocks one-person Dmax liveness
fixtures.purpose: A contradictory target-bound claim pauses the structural Dmax liveness path until ordinary resolution.

payload.proposition: Dmax has not elapsed since cycle 8 began.

notes: Replay does not silently choose between contradictory time claims.

fixtures.title: Survivor path cannot certify beacon
fixtures.purpose: Repeated structural Dmax liveness closures preserve structure but do not satisfy beacon diversity or advance authority.
notes: One human can keep structural repair moving but cannot certify a beacon or move the frontier alone.

fixtures.title: Later normal certification finalizes pending outputs only
fixtures.purpose: Normal multi-identity evidence/challenge/certainty process can later certify timing without validating forbidden constrained-mode actions.
notes: Later certification may finalize explicit pending outputs only.

fixtures.title: Dmin deliberative close
fixtures.purpose: Close structurally when Dmin is true and W_score meets W_target.
notes: Structural close is not certification.

fixtures.title: Dmax forced close
fixtures.purpose: Close structurally when Dmax is true and W_target is unmet.
notes: Dmax implies structural Dmin only.

fixtures.title: Forced cycles never authorize POD, POINT, or governance
fixtures.purpose: Reject attempts to treat forced cycles as authority or to backfill allowances.
notes: Harness-only mutation attempts are not canonical events.

fixtures.title: Certainty contradiction blocks predicate
fixtures.purpose: A contradictory claim at the contradiction threshold blocks Dmin predicate truth.
notes: Contradiction at threshold blocks structural predicate truth.

fixtures.title: Certification gap blocks frontier
fixtures.purpose: Authorization frontier remains contiguous and cannot skip an uncertified cycle.
notes: Cycles 0 and 2 certified is insufficient while cycle 1 is pending.

fixtures.title: External link alone has no certainty effect
fixtures.purpose: Reject direct certainty from a URL/hash without identity-authored evidence ideas and challenge outcomes.
notes: Provenance refs do not replace authored evidence ideas.

fixtures.title: Source-document/source-chunk ideas may support after connection and placement
fixtures.purpose: Show external-source representation as ideas plus explicit connections and challenge outcomes.

payload.proposition: A source document with hash sha256:bbbb exists at archived URL https://example.invalid/archive/time-report.
Section 3 of source_doc_idea_tcf018 reports that the referenced anchor preceded the observed event.
The source chunk supports that Dmin elapsed for tempo_target(0, dmin).

notes: Certainty still requires a certainty-band challenge verdict.

fixtures.title: AI-created canonical evidence and time claims are rejected
fixtures.purpose: Reject AI attempts to create canonical Tempo content or challenge authority.
notes: A human may later adopt AI-assisted material as a human-authored idea, but the AI is not the canonical author.

fixtures.title: Offline/local ideas remain advisory until canonical validation
fixtures.purpose: Local target-bound ideas and cycle simulations have no canonical authority until published and replayed.
notes: Offline material must pass ordinary canonical validation and deterministic replay.

fixtures.title: Tempo/Cycle rejection matrix
fixtures.purpose: Cover remaining deterministic rejection surfaces before runtime replay harness implementation.
notes: Invalid canonical input events remain Appendix A event families; direct derived-state mutations are harness actions.

fixtures.title: Passive evidence alone cannot cross Tallow
fixtures.purpose: Record admissible passive timestamp evidence without any human structural stance and show it cannot satisfy structural readiness.

payload.proposition: A signed envelope timestamp appears consistent with elapsed time, without any target-bound human stance.

notes: The passive evidence is admissible derived input, but no human stance exists.

fixtures.title: Passive evidence plus human support can reach Tallow
fixtures.purpose: Show a required human stance plus capped passive evidence reaching structural readiness without changing ordinary truth certainty.
notes: Tallow permits structural readiness while ordinary truth certainty remains none.

fixtures.title: Passive source dedup prevents amplification
fixtures.purpose: Repeated passive observations from the same source, target, and epoch count once.

payload.proposition: Second committed passive timestamp observation from the same source epoch.

notes: Deduplication key is source_id, target_key, and source_epoch.

fixtures.title: Zero humans enters record-only
fixtures.purpose: With zero participating eligible humans, replay remains readable but emits no universal cycle close.
notes: Machine-only operation cannot create universal structural progression.
